name: Perennial Ragweed
desc: Perennial Ragweed (Ambrosia trifida): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Ambrosia trifida, the giant ragweed, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It is native to North America, where it is widespread in Canada, the United States, and northern Mexico.
